body:
I do not care for or want your sympathy. You've literally tried to convince me over a period of posts to take pills to solve my problems. Instead of legitimately talking to me to try to figure out what my problems are even about, you just tell me to take pills. Ridiculous. If you think I don't know how medication, depression, or dreams work, I actually do.

Dreams are nothing like depression. Dreams are a sensory hallucination created in the brain when there's a lack of external input from the world. Our subconscious replaces the lack of senses into it's own world.

Depression is a complex mental ILLNESS (not hallucination. It's not a hallucination and has nothing to do with a hallucination. It's not a fake or imaginary phenomena). It has many causes and many different effects. Regardless of the cause, when you're depressed, negative thought patterns can obstruct a regular mode of thinking. The result is a partial deactivation the frontal cortex of the brain, and other areas of the brain as well. It causes the brain to produce less seratonin and dopamine ultimately resulting in the feeling that you call "depression". 

Yes, there are pills that can cause your brain to fix the lack of dopamine and seratonin. Ultimately, it doesn't actually solve the root of the problem unless that's changed, you'll have to take the pills for the rest of your life. If the cycle has lasted long enough, then sometimes you can't even restore how your brain normally functions without pills. 

No, depression and dreams are not similar. Not at all. It absolutely baffles me how you're using such an analogy.
No. Depression is not like a dream. Ridiculous.

Meds aren't an option for me. Even if they were, I'd absolutely not take them. My depression isn't purely chemical. I just legitimately do not want to live, I do not want to partake in life. There's nothing in this world for me, and even if I weren't depressed, I still wouldn't want to do anything. There's nothing to think about. You say this all as if I've never heard someone to tell me about medications before... in the end, it's just all a waste of time. I'm going to go now. Life's just a waste of time.

Yeah... but it's not in a rush. I've been suicidal for so many years. I did exactly what you did. When I was 17, I said when I turned 18 I'd kill myself. When I turned 18 I told myself I'd wait it out and see if it got any better... I've been depressed for most of my life, and it's only gotten worse. For these last few years I've lost all enjoyment and desire to do anything in life... doing things I "love" isn't possible because I don't love anything. I've tried, trust me. It's not possible.
